title: custom:tile-group-card-pro
description: Several tiles on one card under a header (title, icon, badges): one under the other (list) or vertical tiles side by side (row). The group sets nothing on its tiles but their layout: each tile says everything about itself. Strings containing {{ }} are Jinja templates rendered by Home Assistant.

layout.description: list: the tiles one under the other; row: vertical tiles side by side, in columns alike, wrapping when narrow

title_tap_action.description: Action when the title or its icon is tapped, e.g. navigate to the room's dashboard (default: none)

badges.description: The header's badges, plain and small unless they say otherwise

tiles.description: The tiles: entity ids or tiles (the tile card's keys, without type, grid_options and vertical: the layout decides it)

visibility.description: Shows the tile only while the conditions hold
